title: BDA Histology
author: Blake Butler
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.z4af8se

steps.title: Reconstitute ABC solution
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the Vectastain ABC solution according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Prepare ABC working solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 80 mL of ABC working solution by mixing 79 mL of 0.1 M Physiological Buffer with 480 µL Solution A and 480 µL Solution B (Avidin/Biotin HRP Complex, Vector Laboratories catalog #PK-6100).

steps.title: Thaw NGS vials
steps.instruction: Thaw six 1 mL vials of NGS (Normal Goat Serum) for later use.

steps.title: Prepare normal goat serum
steps.instruction: Obtain Normal Goat Serum (Cedarlane catalog #CL1200-500) for use in blocking steps.

steps.title: Initial buffer rinse
steps.instruction: Rinse tissue sections in 0.1 M Physiological Buffer for four consecutive washes, 5 minutes each.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.1 M Physiological Buffer to sections; incubate 5 min.
Remove buffer; repeat three more times.

steps.title: Block endogenous peroxidase
steps.instruction: Prepare blocking solution by mixing 105 mL methanol, 45 mL de‑ionized water, and 750 µL of 30 % (v/v) hydrogen peroxide; incubate sections in this solution for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Post‑block buffer rinse
steps.instruction: Rinse sections again in 0.1 M Physiological Buffer for four consecutive washes, 5 minutes each.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.1 M Physiological Buffer; incubate 5 min.
Remove buffer; repeat three more times.

steps.title: Incubate with ABC complex
steps.instruction: Transfer tissue sections to individual reaction wells and incubate in the Avidin/Biotin HRP Complex prepared in step 2 for 1 hour 30 minutes.

steps.title: Rinse after ABC incubation
steps.instruction: Return sections to reaction trays and rinse in 0.1 M Physiological Buffer three times, 10 minutes per rinse.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.1 M Physiological Buffer; incubate 10 min.
Remove buffer; repeat two more times.

steps.title: Incubate in DAB‑Nickel chromogen
steps.instruction: Prepare 150 mL DAB‑Nickel chromogen solution in 0.1 M Physiological Buffer containing 0.1125 g 3,3′‑diaminobenzidine tetrachloride (DAB, Sigma‑Aldrich catalog #D5905), 1.875 mL cobalt chloride (added dropwise), 3 mL nickel ammonium sulfate (added dropwise), and 50 µL 30 % hydrogen peroxide (added 60 seconds before incubation); incubate sections for approximately 20 minutes, monitoring visually for endpoint.

steps.title: Final buffer rinse
steps.instruction: Rinse sections in 0.1 M Physiological Buffer three times, 5 minutes each.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.1 M Physiological Buffer; incubate 5 min.
Remove buffer; repeat two more times.

steps.title: Mount sections
steps.instruction: Mount the stained sections using 0.01 M Physiological Buffer.
